resources.title: Normal Balances & Account Types Quick Reference
resources.description: A one-page cheat sheet pulling together the accounting equation, the normal-balance table for all five account types, the four-step transaction method, the contra-asset exception (Accumulated Depreciation), and the accrual/deferral 2x2 map — everything from Chapters 1 through 5 you need at your fingertips while you record transactions.

resources.title: Trial Balance Worksheet Template
resources.description: A blank, ready-to-fill trial balance worksheet pre-loaded with the common account names used throughout this course (assets, liabilities, equity, revenue, and expense accounts), with Debit and Credit columns left empty so you can post your own practice transactions and total both columns yourself, exactly as shown in Lesson 17.

resources.title: Month-End Close Checklist
resources.description: A ready-to-use, checkbox-style month-end close procedure built directly from Lesson 29, plus the additional year-end-only steps and the Lesson 18 trial-balance troubleshooting steps folded in as a built-in escalation path — copy it into your own close procedure or an Oracle Fusion client engagement.
